Axiom: External research (WebSearch/WebFetch) run in this session ALWAYS lands as a research document via `npx gennady sdd-new research --scope --slug ` — filled in BEFORE the result feeds a proposal to the operator; a chat summary is not storage (session dies, research dies with it). Every factual claim must be re-verifiable: traced to a source (a specific page, URL + access date; for code-derived facts — path + commit) OR explicitly flagged `agent conclusion` / `from model memory as of `. A fact carrying neither is a document defect, not a style choice. A repeat question checks existing `specs/**/research/` first — supersede, never duplicate.
